metaDescription: Office movers in Orange County for the IBC, Irvine Spectrum or South Coast Metro: a COI sent to your building, phased daytime moves, 8AM – 6PM.
heroTitle: Office & Commercial Movers in Orange County
heroSubtitle: Suites, campus offices and towers moved in planned phases, with the building's COI sent before day one

faq.question: How is travel from Los Angeles billed on an Orange County office move?
faq.answer: Our crews set out from Los Angeles, so any driving beyond 10 miles is billed at double time, and a site 30+ miles from the base has a 4-hour minimum rather than 3. The estimate shows the travel time for your two addresses before you book.

faq.question: Our Irvine building wants a certificate of insurance. Can you send it?
faq.answer: Yes. The COI costs $50 and goes to your property manager before the move date. Some buildings, such as 2050 Main Street, also expect the tenant to notify management and name the contractor in advance, so plan that notice alongside our paperwork.

faq.question: Can a large office move be split across a weekend?
faq.answer: Yes. Crews work Monday – Sunday between 8AM and 6PM, so a bigger company usually moves in phases, one floor or department per day, with Saturday and Sunday available. We do not run night moves.

faq.question: Do you move industrial machinery?
faq.answer: Our commercial service covers office furniture, workstations, IT equipment and servers, files, break-room appliances and medical office equipment. Production machinery is outside that list. A single item over 300 lbs within it moves with a crew of three for a $150 charge.

faq.question: Does the type of office building change the plan?
faq.answer: It does. A one- or two-story campus building usually loads through a ground-level door, while a high-rise of five floors or more needs dock and freight elevator time booked through management. We ask about the building type on the first call.

faq.question: Can you move a small office the same day we call?
faq.answer: Often, yes: we take same-day office jobs whenever a crew is open. The working window is still 8AM – 6PM and the county distance rules still apply, so a morning call leaves the most room.
